description: A Claude or Codex subscription account kept on a host (Settings → Subscriptions): what a head sees of it; its credential never leaves the host.

id.description: Its id on its host (what a session's kept with).

name.description: Its name, the user's, unique for its provider on its host.

kind.description: folder: a Claude account that is a config folder of its own on its host (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), signed in to with claude auth login run there with it (signed in again the same way); token: a Claude account signed in with a token from claude setup-token or an Anthropic API key (signed in again by replacing it); profile: a Codex account, a CODEX_HOME of its own, signed in with ChatGPT or an OpenAI API key (signed in again with codex login).
